text_block_list.text:
You're still running, McQueen? I thought
you
were already done with training.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Yes, well... I may have overindulged
during lunch,
so I thought it best to
exercise a bit more to—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Goodness! There's such a thing as tact,
you know!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Wait, lemme get this straight. You're
satisfied
with a boring old diet?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
A boring old diet? Are you meaning to
imply that
there exists another kind of
diet?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! It's called "Golshi's
Patented
Slimming Technique"!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The name doesn't quite inspire
confidence... Is it
truly an effective
technique?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Oh, for sure! Not that I've tested it out
before!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Then that's no more than false
advertising! Now
please leave me be so I
can continue my run!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Now hang on! I can prove it works!
C'mon, let's
work together and spread
my technique around
the world!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I said no. Now if you'll excuse me, I'm
busy
conditioning myself the
old-fashioned way!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Aw, humor me a little! The first step's
easy! All
you gotta do is shout "Begone,
flab!" while
running!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: H-hush! Don't yell that so loudly!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
No can do! Some dreams only come true
if you
say them out loud!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Stop this instant! There's some things
that never
need to be said aloud!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Голд Шипп is noticeably
leaner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Golshi's Patented
Slimming
Technique hasn't caught on at
all.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
